open_decisions.question: Who coordinates the order (a role, such as the club's treasurer or the project lead)?
How many members want each line? Collect anonymous counts, then update the lines.
Does the club pay and collect later, or do members pay suppliers directly? Ask the officers what the university allows for student-organization purchases.
Who is the importer of record, and which delivery address is allowed? Keep the address off GitHub.
Request quotes from at least two suppliers per factory line, using the template in docs/group-order.md.
Ask the carrier for a delivered-duty-paid quote, and check the duty rate with US Customs before ordering.
Who inspects arriving parts, and what are the acceptance tests? The lines list the tests.
How are parts split among members, and what happens to leftover stock? Keep the records in the club's private channel.
Order the small distributor samples first and build one test motor before the factory order.

lines.name: N52 disc magnets, 10 x 2 mm: sample from a distributor
lines.inspection: Weigh and caliper a few discs. Pull-test one. Check the coating for chips.
lines.note: Enough for one test motor (14 discs) with spares. Lets the team test the winding and the pull before the factory order. Magnets pinch fingers and shatter if they snap together: use spacers.

lines.name: 684ZZ miniature bearings, 4 x 9 x 4 mm: sample from a retailer
lines.inspection: Spin each bearing by hand and listen. Check radial play with a dial gauge if one is available.
lines.note: The same size is sold as MR94ZZ. Compare the factory order against this sample.

lines.name: N52 disc magnets, 10 x 2 mm, from a factory
candidates: An Alibaba listing at a 1,000-piece minimum
lines.inspection: Pull-test ten samples from the batch. Check grade marking, coating and magnetization direction against the datasheet. Calipers for size.
lines.note: Ask for the grade, the coating, the magnetization direction (axial), the tolerance, packaging for strong magnets, and the delivered-duty-paid price. Candidates come from listings and are not vetted.

lines.name: 684ZZ miniature bearings, 4 x 9 x 4 mm, from a factory
lines.inspection: Spin-test every bearing from a sample of twenty. Check radial play and noise. Reject any that stick.
lines.note: Quality varies at this price. Ask for the precision grade and the lubricant.

lines.name: Enamelled copper wire, 0.3 mm, 1 kg spools
lines.inspection: Check the diameter with calipers and the enamel with a continuity test.
lines.note: The factory minimum is 300 kg, so buy spools. Salvaged wire from old motors and transformers can replace part of this.

lines.name: Hardened steel motor shafts
lines.inspection: Check the diameter against the chosen bearing bore, and the straightness on a flat surface.
lines.note: Not searched. The price is a placeholder.
